change_summary: Test the fixed USDA FAS as-published corn/soy export-sales p75 composite as a shared default-off ten-leg agriculture event basket under the standard three-window full-stack protocol.

hypothesis: Shared-paper-first alpha: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service weekly Export Sales Reporting as-published archived corn and soybean current-plus-next marketing-year net-sales strength, measured only against prior seasonal observations and prior composite scores, may add after-cost ten-session value through one fixed ten-leg agriculture value-chain event basket entered at the first regular open after the official 08:30 ET publication; no revised API values, price confirmation, or post-result retuning.
next_retry_requires: At least 10 additional prospectively settled releases selected by the unchanged frozen policy, bringing the settled count from 15 to at least 25 (+66.7% and +10), accumulated before outcome inspection and evaluated once under a preregistered cutoff.
Alternatively, a genuinely independent point-in-time data source or signal, not another USDA ESR field or subtype, with at least 12 settled events and at least 3 per standard window.
notes: Rejected: aggregate EV -0.0458 and PnL -496.80; all three windows regressed on EV, only 3 of 10 tickers contributed positively, concentration caps failed, and the target lost every required aggregate matched comparator. Fifteen independent settled releases and Gate2/Gate3 passed. DSR is honestly not computable for one trial. No run.py or live behavior changed.

locked_variables: official ESRQS archived weekly PDF bytes and sha256;Corn and Soybeans current plus next marketing-year net sales;prior-five-calendar-year same-ISO-week plus-minus-two empirical midrank percentile with minimum fifteen observations;equal mean of corn and soybean percentiles;strictly above nearest-rank p75 of exactly prior 104 valid composites;ten-session event cooldown;fixed basket CORN SOYB DBA ADM BG CTVA DE MOS NTR CF;500 USD per eligible leg with no redistribution;all ten legs required;ETF ADV20 at least 250000 USD and notional at most 0.2 percent ADV;equity ADV20 at least 50000000 USD;price at least 10 USD;official Thursday 08:30 ET availability and first regular open at or after release;3.5 ATR14 target otherwise tenth-session close;35 bps round-trip cost;cash SPY QQQ DBA and equal CORN-SOYB matched benchmarks;no threshold basket weight hold cost or window retune

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Park this USDA ESR signal surface. Do not spend another ID on percentile, seasonal/lookback, cooldown, corn-only/soy-only, report-field/subtype, late-window, basket member/weight, hold, ATR-target, cost, response-shape, or price-confirmation retunes. The late-window positive PnL is not a rescue lead because its EV remained negative and it lost SPY and QQQ.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only after at least 10 additional prospectively settled unchanged-policy releases (15 to at least 25), or with a genuinely independent PIT data source/signal rather than another USDA ESR field or subtype. Until then, readiness checks are one-line counts and do not reserve an experiment ID.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: A high seasonal level of weekly corn/soy export sales was not an unanticipated price-relevant demand shock. The fixed basket mixed commodity, processor, fertilizer, seed, and equipment exposures that did not move together: only 3 of 10 tickers contributed positively, every window lost EV, and all required aggregate matched benchmarks beat the target.

prediction.confidence_reason: The source is genuinely new and the no-ID preflight lower bound already yields 13 independent p75/cooldown events with 6/3/4 window coverage and complete ten-leg prices after replacing missing MOO with CF, but recent official-source baskets repeatedly failed concentration and comparator gates.

rejection_reason: Gate 4 rejected aggregate EV -0.0458 and PnL -496.80: all three windows lost EV; only the late window improved PnL; breadth and all three concentration caps failed; every required aggregate matched benchmark and both accepted candidate-pool bars were not beaten.
measurement_limitations: The repository retains each PDF endpoint, raw SHA-256, exact crop excerpts, page indices, and derivation evidence, but not the complete PDF bytes. Future USDA replacement or withdrawal is detectable as hash drift, yet a full offline reparse would require refetching the matching bytes.

The official archive contains only 47 canonical 2019 weeks and 51 canonical 2022 weeks after audit exclusions. Seasonal comparisons still satisfy the locked minimum of 15 observations, but finite-sample uncertainty remains.
Only one preregistered policy was attempted, so Deflated Sharpe is correctly not computable and supplies no live-readiness evidence.
fingerprint_caveat: Reservation-time classification routed the genuinely new USDA source to other/event_basket_10d. This experiment added narrow usda_fas_export_sales/event_basket_10d coverage; the rebuilt frozen-family entry must use the corrected source key.
